stem: Bella wants a better closing sentence for her letter. Which sentence should replace sentence 33?

options.label: A
options.text: I think it is going to be wonderful to have a pen pal from another country.

options.label: B
options.text: This will be a really good way for me to get more practice with my typing skills.

options.label: C
options.text: Mrs. Sánchez said we would probably write our letters during class on Fridays.

options.label: D
options.text: My mom told me she also had a pen pal when she was in elementary school.

visual_elements: multiple choice options in a box with rounded corners.
